subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 lands, should the exact-head removal of `@openclaw/qa-matrix`, its private facade, and its lockfile importer be authorized and merged?
rationale: The code is internally consistent and proven, but only a maintainer can confirm that the source-only compatibility package has no remaining supported consumers and authorize the protected dependency-graph change.

options.title: Land stack and authorize removal
options.body: Merge the predecessor first, refresh the exact-head review, and approve the intentional package and lockfile importer removal.

options.title: Pause package retirement
options.body: Keep the compatibility package and facade until maintainers finish auditing source-checkout consumers or define a deprecation window.

recommendation.title: Land stack and authorize removal
recommendation.body: Merge the predecessor first, refresh the exact-head review, and approve the intentional package and lockfile importer removal.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QA Lab and repository integration history makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the final compatibility and dependency-authorization decision.
